name: Otome Renshin Prister Fandisc ~Motto H ni Koi Seyo Otome!~
original_name: 乙女恋心プリスターFANDISC ～もっとHに恋せよ乙女!～
source:
This is the fandisc for Prister, with after stories for each of the 12 heroines, another stories for 6 popular subheroines, as well as a possible harem route.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/07/01/july-2010-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]

这是《Prister》的同人光盘，其中有12位女主角的后续故事，还有6位受欢迎的女主角的故事，以及可能的后宫路线。

[来自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/07/01/july-2010-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri！[/url]]
